identityResolution.statement: The reviewed USGS paragraph identifies a historical extraction-to-electrowinning process. It does not identify the physical refinery by name, stable external identifier or location. Baryon role keys are not verified physical facility IDs.
identityResolution.admissionRule: Before attaching output, inventory, assay or shipment data, require a permitted dated source explicitly linking the physical facility and process to this historical role for the observation interval. Common ownership, project names and similar names are insufficient. No link to Johnson Camp or another related asset is established here.

process: Acid leaches copper underground. Recovery wells pump copper-bearing solution to an electrowinning refinery that produces cathodes.
constraint: USGS reports that carbon-dioxide bubbles impeded flow in rock fractures. At yearend 2022, the timing of full-capacity operation was unresolved.
scope: Historical operating evidence, not a current supplier offer. Role keys and process links do not establish physical facility identity or geographic routes. No subsurface geometry, reserve estimate, current production forecast or available supply is inferred.
